# Answers from the owner (workflow dry run, T041)

The owner's answers in the "Draft a deck from any source" dry run on `tests/fixtures/sample-source.md`, written down word for word as the workflow asks. The agent asked through the question tool on 2026-11-21.

## Asked

How do you want to handle it? (The dry run drafts a small deck from the sample file, and may only use words from that file or from the owner's answers.)

## Answered

Source words only: "use the sample's own headings and sentences, Averlo brand". The second run with another brand uses "Sample Co" and no logo, so the placeholder shows.

## What the agent drafted from it

- Dry run 1: brand Averlo, one language (en). Slides use the sample's own headings as titles and its own sentences as text.
- Dry run 2: brand Sample Co, with no logo or mark yet, so the intro and the hard-load screen show the "your logo" placeholder. Same slides.

## Dry run of the deck-visuals skill (T144, feature 002)

The skill proposed a visual for each part of the sample source. The owner answered through the question tool on 2026-11-22, word for word:

- "Why we are launching now": Stat cards (Recommended). "Cards: 'eight weeks' (pilot), 'three offices', 'under a minute' (to book a desk), values exactly as written."
- "The plan": Timeline (Recommended). "Four events in date order: Finish testing (April), Train the office managers (early May), Open the app (start of June), Review the launch (end of June)."
- "What the first release does": Compare (Recommended). "Left: the four features. Right: 'Payments and meeting rooms are not in the first release. We will look at them after the launch.'"
- "Risks" and "How we will know it worked": Table + Stat cards (Recommended). "Risks as a comparison table (risk / what we do); targets as stat cards: 'half of the staff' (book a desk in the first month), 'fewer than ten' (support questions a week)."
